dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: 本日はどんなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: はい、コロナの影響で、14年勤めだ会社が倒産してしまい、ショックなんです。
dialogue.English: Yes, due to the impact of COVID-19, the company I've worked for for 14 years has gone bankrupt, and I'm in shock.

dialogue.content: 14年も勤められた会社が、、、それはとても衝撃を受けてしまいますね
dialogue.English: A company you've worked at for 14 years... That must be a huge shock.

dialogue.content: まったく信じられません。3年前にはマイホームを買い、ローンを組んだばかりなのに。
dialogue.English: I just can't believe it. We bought a home three years ago and had only just taken out the mortgage.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、出費がある中での倒産となると，今後のことが心配になりますよね，，，
dialogue.English: I see. With those expenses, having the company go under makes you worry about the future, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: これから、私達家族はどうしていけばいいんでしょうか
dialogue.English: What is our family supposed to do from now on?

dialogue.content: ご家族の生活がかかっていますものね。とても大切なお話ですので，解決できるよう，一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: Your family's livelihood is at stake. This is a very important matter, so let's think it through together to find a solution.

dialogue.content: はい、まさかこんなことになるとは、夢にも思っていなかっただけに、行き先まっくらです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I never dreamed this would happen, so everything feels pitch black ahead.

dialogue.content: 叫びたくなるような気持ちになってしまいます。
dialogue.English: I just feel like screaming.

dialogue.content: ご自身のことだけでもかなり大変な状況なのに，ご家族のことも，，，と考えると不安でいっぱいになってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: It's an incredibly difficult situation for you personally, and when you also think about your family... it's natural to be filled with anxiety.

dialogue.content: 夜も眠れません
dialogue.English: I can't sleep at night.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。疲れも溜まってしまいますね，，，
dialogue.English: I see. That must be exhausting...

dialogue.content: 今，特に不安が大きいのはどのようなことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What is causing you the most anxiety right now?

dialogue.content: もう、限界です。
dialogue.English: I'm at my limit.

dialogue.content: 家のローンと生活費です
dialogue.English: It's the mortgage and our living expenses.

dialogue.content: お辛いですよね，，，
dialogue.English: That must be so difficult...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ローンと生活費ですね。経済面は早急にどうにかしないとと思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: The loan and living expenses. It's natural to feel you need to do something about your finances urgently.

dialogue.content: 今現在，どのくらい経済的な負担があるのでしょうかか？
dialogue.English: Right now, how much of a financial burden are you facing?

dialogue.content: はい、ローンを入れると、月30万位かかっています。
dialogue.English: Including the mortgage, it comes to about 300,000 yen a month.

dialogue.content: 30万も，，，それは会社の倒産に叫びたくもなりますね，，，
dialogue.English: 300,000 yen... No wonder you feel like screaming about the company's bankruptcy.

dialogue.content: はい、少しの間は貯金を切り崩してと思っています。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm thinking we'll have to dip into our savings for a while.

dialogue.content: 仕事を探していますが、コロナで、なかなかしごともありません。
dialogue.English: I'm looking for a job, but with the pandemic, it's hard to find anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね，，，貯金に頼ってしまうのも心落ち着かないですよね，，，
dialogue.English: I see... It must be unsettling to have to rely on your savings...

dialogue.content: お仕事はすでに探していらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: So you've already started looking for work.

dialogue.content: 今の時期の職探しは本当に難しいですよね
dialogue.English: Job hunting is especially difficult at a time like this, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: せっかく建てた、家も手放すようかど、迷っています。
dialogue.English: I'm even torn about whether we should let go of the house we worked so hard to build.

dialogue.content: 行き先真っ暗です
dialogue.English: Everything feels pitch black ahead.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね，，，ギリギリの状況の中，踏ん張っておられるのですね
dialogue.English: I see... You're holding on as best you can in a very tight situation.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者様以外に，ご家族の収入はありますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Besides yourself, is there any other income in your household?

dialogue.content: 主人の会社もコロナで、お給料が滞っているじょうたいです
dialogue.English: My husband's company has also been affected by COVID, and his salary payments are delayed.

dialogue.content: 毎日、電車での人身事故のニュースを見ています。私たちと同じように、もう、限界だったんだろうと、とても他人事には思いません
dialogue.English: Every day, I see news about people involved in train accidents. I can't help but think it's not someone else's problem, that maybe they were at their limit too, just like us.

dialogue.content: ご主人も，，，
dialogue.English: Your husband as well...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 事故のニュースが増えると気になってしまいますよね，，，
dialogue.English: When there's more news of such accidents, it's hard not to be affected by it...

dialogue.content: ご主人のお給料が入る目処はたっているのでしょうか，，，？
dialogue.English: Is there any indication of when your husband might receive his salary?

dialogue.content: お給料の日にちが、はっきりと決まらない状態です
dialogue.English: Right now there's no clear date for payday.

dialogue.content: なるほど，いつ入るのかと心配になりますね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be stressful not knowing when it will come in.

dialogue.content: もう、家も手放すしかないですね。
dialogue.English: It seems we have no choice but to let go of the house.

dialogue.content: 本当にギリギリなのですね，，，いまの状況はとても苦しいですよね
dialogue.English: You really are at a breaking point... this must be a very painful situation.

dialogue.content: ちなみに，ご主人のお給料が入った場合，負担はどの程度になりそうですか？
dialogue.English: Just to ask, if your husband's salary does come through, how much would that ease the burden?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お給料もいくら貰えるか、今のところわからないので、あてに出来ない状態です
dialogue.English: We don't even know how much he'll be paid, so at this point we can't count on it.

dialogue.content: なるほど，，，コロナの影響で今まで通りともいかないのですね
dialogue.English: I see... So because of the pandemic, things aren't the same as they used to be.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 本当に辛いです。
dialogue.English: It's really hard.

dialogue.content: 先行きが見えないのは本当に不安になりますよね，，，。今のこの状況を，ご主人や他の家族の方とお話はされましたか？
dialogue.English: Not being able to see what's ahead is truly unsettling, isn't it? Have you talked about this situation with your husband or other family members?

dialogue.content: 毎日、暗くお通夜のようです。話しても先がみえないので、
dialogue.English: Every day feels gloomy, like a wake. Even when we talk, we can't see a way forward.

dialogue.content: そうなってしまいますよね，，，ご主人とはあまりお話をされていないのですね
dialogue.English: That's understandable... So you haven't been talking much with your husband.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: ご相談者様やご主人のご両親はどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What about your parents or your husband's parents?

dialogue.content: はい、両親はもういないので、家中にいても、うつになりそうなので、もう一度、職安にでも行って、なんの仕事出もよいので、もう一度探してこようと思います。今のつらいきもちを聴いて、いただいで一歩まえに進まなければと思いました。
dialogue.English: My parents are no longer with us. Staying at home all the time is making me feel depressed, so I think I'll go to the employment office again and look for any kind of job. Having you listen to these painful feelings has made me realize I need to take a step forward.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。そうですね，外に出られた方が気分転換にもなるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. You're right, getting out of the house might be a good change of pace.

dialogue.content: はい、頑張ってみます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll try my best.

dialogue.content: もしよろしければ，私からも1つできそうなことを考えてみたのですが，そのために少し今までのお話を整理してもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If it's alright with you, I've thought of one thing that might be helpful. To explain it, may I briefly summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: コロナの影響で14年勤めた会社が倒産，それに加えてご主人の会社のお給料も滞っている状況で，まずは生活に影響が出ていますね
dialogue.English: Due to COVID-19, the company you worked for for 14 years went bankrupt, and on top of that, your husband's salary is delayed, which is affecting your daily life first and foremost.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 生活だけでも苦しい中で，3年前に建てたマイホームのローンがのしかかってきてしまい，相当負担がかかっている状態になっていますね
dialogue.English: On top of the difficulty with living expenses, the mortgage for the home you built three years ago is weighing on you, creating a significant burden.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 毎日お通夜のように暗くなってしまうご自宅では，ご主人ともあまり話し合いができずにいらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: At home, where the atmosphere has become gloomy like a wake, you haven't been able to discuss things much with your husband.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんな中でもご相談者様は仕事を一生懸命探されていますし，生きることを考えてマイホームを手放すべきかどうかも考えておられます
dialogue.English: Even in such circumstances, you're diligently searching for a job and considering whether to let go of your home to keep going.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お話を聴いていて，この先が見えない不安な状況の中，相談者様は「職探し」と「マイホームについて」の2点で少しでも先が見えるようにしようと頑張っていらっしゃいると思いました。
dialogue.English: Listening to you, it seems that in this uncertain situation, you are trying hard to see a way forward by focusing on two things: 'job hunting' and 'your home'.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そこで私からの提案ですが，ご主人と今後についてゆっくりと話し合う機会を設けてみてはいかがでしょうか？ご自宅では暗くなってしまうかもしれないので，外の方が落ち着いてお話ができるのではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: So, my suggestion is, how about setting aside time to calmly discuss the future with your husband? Since home might feel gloomy, perhaps talking outside would allow for a more relaxed conversation.

dialogue.content: そうですね、外だったら、はなしもしやすいかも知れませんね
dialogue.English: You're right—if we were outside, it might be easier to talk.

dialogue.content: 生活費についても，ローンについても，相談者様1人で抱えることではなく，ご主人と一緒に考えることなのではないかと思います。相談者様は1人で頑張っておられるように見えますので，その頑張りを形にできるよう，ご主人と協力するのが良いのではないかと思いました。
dialogue.English: I believe that both the living expenses and the loan are not things for you to bear alone, but to think about together with your husband. It seems you've been trying to handle this all by yourself, so I thought that cooperating with your husband might be a good way to make your efforts more fruitful.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: もう、限界と決めつけていましたが、もう一度、これからのことを、主人と話し合ってみようと、思います。
dialogue.English: I had convinced myself that I was at my limit, but I think I'll try to talk with my husband about our future one more time.

dialogue.content: コロナのこともありますので，カフェなどが難しければ，お散歩しながらや公園などでも良いかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: With the pandemic, if a café is difficult, perhaps you could talk while taking a walk or at a park.

dialogue.content: はい，ぜひ，ご主人とお話してみてください。
dialogue.English: Yes, please do try talking with your husband.

dialogue.content: そうですね、明日にでも、外に行けるよう話してみます
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll talk to him tomorrow about going outside to talk.

dialogue.content: 相談者様は今すでに職安に行こうという前向きな意思と行動力をお持ちですので，きっとご主人ともしっかり話し合うことができると思いますよ
dialogue.English: You already have the positive intention and initiative to go to the employment office, so I'm sure you'll be able to have a good discussion with your husband.

dialogue.content: そうですか、先ずは、話し合いですね、聞いて頂き何かきもちも、楽になってきました。
dialogue.English: You think so? Yes, talking it over is the first step. Thank you for listening, I feel a little lighter now.

dialogue.content: 少しでもお役に立てたのなら幸いです
dialogue.English: I'm glad if I could be of even a little help.

dialogue.content: 状況が今より少しでも良くなるよう，願っております
dialogue.English: I hope your situation improves, even just a little.

dialogue.content: 、また、辛くなたら、聞いて下さい。
dialogue.English: If things get tough again, please listen to me.

dialogue.content: ええ，いつでもお待ちしております
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm always here for you.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: はい，こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you as well.

dialogue.content: 勇気を持って聞いて頂いて、良かったです
dialogue.English: I'm glad I had the courage to reach out and have you listen.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: いつでもこちらにお越しくださいね。それでは，本日のご相談を終了とさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come here anytime. With that, we'll conclude today's session.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。合掌
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much. Gassho.

dialogue.content: ご相談いただき，ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your concerns with me.

dialogue.content: (これでロールプレイを修了させていただきます。本日はありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (This concludes the role-playing session. Thank you for today.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。合掌
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Gassho.
